title: Ghost Interviewer Can Finally Hear the Browser Tab | vitalii.no
description:
How a live interview transcription tool stopped bouncing audio off speakers and a microphone, and started listening to the browser tab directly.

Until now, the only way to transcribe an interviewer talking through a video call was a strange workaround: let their voice play out through your speakers, then pick it back up again with the microphone. That round trip added room noise and echo, and on a laptop with no physical path from the call audio to the mic input, it simply failed.

The app now adds a tab-audio source that requests the browser's own screen-and-tab-audio sharing dialog and keeps that shared stream alive for the whole session, cloning it every time the recognizer needs to restart. The option sits right next to the regular microphone choice, no extra hardware needed.

A fresh recognizer run also needs a moment to produce its first word, so the restart timer that used to kill it too early was stretched from 6 seconds to 12 seconds, giving it room to actually start.
